scope: 33 frozen definitions: saved configuration12, policy7, Keychain14; isolated paths and fake security adapters only. No actual system policy or Keychain access.
semantics: A whole definition is covered only when all assertions and local variants have executed native counterparts. Native String errors, unexecuted platform branches and untested CLI injection paths remain explicit gaps.

mappings.name: the security tool receives secrets on stdin only and reads them back to confirm the save
mappings.parameter_review: Reviewed every local loop/variant inside this definition; inventory parameterized=false does not omit local loops.
review_notes: Escaped secret goes only through stdin; exact read/delete argument arrays, confirmed write/readback, missing item and both successful/missing removal paths pass.
remaining: The baseline observes executable /usr/bin/security through its subprocess mock. NativeSecurityRunner hardcodes that path, but the fake SecurityRunner boundary records arguments/input only; no retained executable-selection observation closes that assertion.

mappings.name: keychain failures are generic, and invalid or unsupported use is rejected
mappings.parameter_review: Reviewed every local loop/variant inside this definition; inventory parameterized=false does not omit local loops.
review_notes: Read/remove/write51 errors are generic, interactive success plus missing readback fails, all three invalid secrets reject with the expected ASCII error, unavailable adapter rejects and advertises false.

mappings.name: the keychain store keeps secrets out of the file and loads them back
mappings.parameter_review: Reviewed every local loop/variant inside this definition; inventory parameterized=false does not omit local loops.
review_notes: Exact secret-free file,0600 mode, two recovered secrets, keychain provenance, absent router token, disjoint second config path and environment override are all tested.

mappings.name: changing the store moves saved secrets in both directions without loss
mappings.parameter_review: Reviewed every local loop/variant inside this definition; inventory parameterized=false does not omit local loops.
review_notes: Runtime file-to-Keychain and back preserve values, remove items and leave no plaintext in Keychain mode.
remaining: Native CLI set/unset store transitions and both migration messages/privacy checks are not exercised with a fake Keychain. Runtime operations alone do not cover the command routing and output assertions.

mappings.name: secret edits under the keychain store update and delete only keychain items

review_notes: No direct native Keychain command edit sequence is retained.
remaining: Secret --stdin edit, exact saved message, unrelated port preservation and explicit unset deletion need an internal fake-Keychain CLI test.

remaining: The exact config set store=file rejection through the command layer, followed by unlocked item values and unchanged store file, is not retained.

review_notes: Failed runtime Keychain write preserves plaintext file bytes exactly.
remaining: The baseline initiates this failure through config set AUTOROUTER_SECRET_STORE keychain; no retained fake-Keychain command test covers that dispatch/error boundary.

remaining: Explicit macOS Keychain setup, off-macOS rejection before prompting, invalid store rejection, forced return to file, key cleanup and exact message need a controlled internal setup test seam.
